summary: The Unified Roadmap prioritizes a three-outcome pilot: Coordination receiver owns V3 /3 compatibility; the .github copy-accounting owner, with Programme accountable until transfer, owns a finite UTEL cap; SystemAdmin owns the authority service with separate policy and credential-custody responsibilities. One six-field owning issue per outcome, one independent source review, one active PR per coherent change, three scope-based delivery classes, a versioned CI acceptance result, decision-driven updates and consolidated durable knowledge capture are the selected replacement route. The target is an evidenced coordination-effort ratio at or below 0.20 against a comparable current-route baseline, faster delivery and unchanged correctness, custody and replay protection. Protected governance source alone does not activate the route: distinct owning issues, qualified acceptance-result producers and consumers, and automatic reply notification with missed-event/restart reconciliation remain gates. Existing CI, original-effect admission, five-minute issue checks and 65,536-byte UTEL cap remain until each replacement qualifies. Completed /3 source is historical evidence, not prospective pilot savings; .103 stays attempted-unknown and unreplayed.
title: Pilot three accountable outcomes with conditional process replacement
